result.summary: Wrote r2/lit.md addressing the 4 literature topics (L1 shape-vs-level of realized-variance time series; L2 robust alternatives to raw skewness on positive series; L3 intraday volume-timing vs volatility-timing; L4 nominal price net of market cap) from r2/analysis.md §5. Used WebSearch (loaded via ToolSearch) restricted to sources confirmed first-published before 2023-08-08; one WebFetch 404'd and was discarded rather than guessed at. Produced 18 new sources [S21]-[S38] (continuing r1's numbering), each with title/author/year-month/venue/link/verified flag, plus explicit 'could not find' notes for constructs the literature does not test (e.g., skewness of a stock's own realized-variance series as a cross-sectional factor; volume/volatility timing-centroid or their lead-lag as an individual-stock factor; China A-share nominal-price-net-of-size studies). Flagged two methodological corrections for the PI: (1) coefficient of variation measures dispersion, not asymmetry, correcting a conflation in the task's own framing; (2) Green-Hwang-style nominal-price comovement evidence mostly vanishes once momentum is controlled for (Chen/Singal/Whitelaw 2016), and the allowed 6 daily leaves cannot fully separate the mechanical price-history or relative-tick microstructure confounds the literature identifies for raw nominal price. Two sources carry a residual verification caveat (noted inline): [S31] full author list unconfirmed, [S35] final journal of record unconfirmed (secondary-source only). All read/write boundaries from the task were respected; no code/config changes, no commits.
